description: This source file defines a composable UI component 'HomeCard' for Android TV applications using Jetpack Compose. It provides two variants of a content card: a default poster card and a TV channel card, each with detailed layout and styling, including focus handling, progress bars, labels, badges, and optional channel icons. The components are designed to be pixel-accurate and derive their geometry and colors from theme assets, catering to a TV UI with precise placement and visual hierarchy.

classes.name: HomeCardVariant
classes.description: Enumeration defining the presentation variant of the HomeCard: Default or TvChannel.

methods.name: HomeCard
methods.description: Main composable function that renders the content card based on the specified variant, providing parameters for card data, size, styling, and feature flags.

methods.name: DefaultPosterCard
methods.description: Private composable implementing the default poster variant with layout for poster, progress bar, and title box.

methods.name: TvChannelCard
methods.description: Private composable implementing the TV channel variant including poster, channel info, live badge, progress, and channel icon overlay.
